steps.disclaimer: The Grid Nexus does not recover accounts or request account credentials. Follow the official process.

steps.body: Discord account theft often comes with a token stealer. Sign out on the infected device and do not reuse it until cleaned.
steps.title: Isolate a possibly infected device first

steps.body: Changing your Discord password logs out all other sessions, revoking a stolen token.
steps.title: Change your password from a clean device

steps.body: Turn on 2FA so a stolen password or token alone cannot take the account back over.
steps.title: Enable two-factor authentication

steps.body: Use Discord's official support flow to report the compromise and recover access if you are locked out.
steps.title: Report the compromised account to Discord

steps.body: Check which third-party apps and bots have access and revoke anything you do not recognize.
steps.title: Review authorized apps and bots

steps.disclaimer: The Grid Nexus does not recover accounts or request account credentials. Follow the official process.

steps.body: If malware is suspected, avoid signing in from the infected device until it is cleaned.
steps.title: Use a clean device

steps.body: Confirm you still control the email address and enable its own two-factor authentication.
steps.title: Secure the email on the Epic account

steps.body: Use Epic's official recovery form; do not trust third-party 'recovery agents'.
steps.title: Submit Epic's official account-recovery request

steps.body: Turn on Epic's 2FA after regaining access so the account cannot be re-taken with a password alone.
steps.title: Enable two-factor authentication

steps.body: Unlink any unfamiliar console or social accounts that could be used to sign in.
steps.title: Review linked external accounts

steps.disclaimer: The Grid Nexus does not recover accounts or request account credentials. Follow the official Steam Support process.

steps.body: If you suspect malware, avoid signing in from the possibly infected device until it has been cleaned.
steps.title: Use a different trusted device if possible

steps.body: Confirm you still control the email address, change its password if needed, and enable its own two-factor authentication.
steps.title: Secure the email connected to Steam

steps.body: Use Steam Support directly rather than a search-result link or a third-party recovery service.
steps.title: Start Steam's official account-recovery process

steps.body: After regaining access, deauthorize unfamiliar devices and review Steam Guard settings.
steps.title: Review authorized devices and Steam Guard

steps.body: If you did not intentionally create an API key, revoke it through Steam's official API key page.
steps.title: Review Steam Web API key access
